subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should clownfish own a warmed snapshot-fork workspace backend for issue workers, and should that use mitos directly or wait for a crabbox lease primitive?
rationale: Current main has target checkout plumbing but no warmed pool; choosing the backend, rollout mode, cache policy, and isolation contract is a maintainer architecture decision rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Keep open for design
options.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

options.title: Defer to external runner primitive
options.body: Leave clownfish on current temporary checkouts until mitos or crabbox exposes a stable primitive, then track only the integration work.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide warmed fork orchestration belongs entirely outside clownfish.

recommendation.title: Keep open for design
recommendation.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest recent owner of the target checkout and executor lifecycle code that this feature would need to extend.
